requirements.quote:
CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1c is used to signal errors
   at only the QUIC layer, or the absence of errors (with the NO_ERROR
   code).  The CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d is used to
   signal an error with the application that uses QUIC.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the frame to signal a QUIC-layer error or the absence of errors with NO_ERROR.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use type 0x1c to signal an application error.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the frame type with the error domain and error code selected by the sender.

requirements.quote:
code).  The CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d is used to
   signal an error with the application that uses QUIC.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the frame to signal an error in the application that uses QUIC.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use type 0x1d to signal a QUIC-layer error or a no-error closure.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can verify that the selected frame variant agrees with the domain of the reported error.

requirements.quote:
If there are open streams that have not been explicitly closed, they
   are implicitly closed when the connection is closed.
requirements.condition: The connection is closed while streams remain open and have not been explicitly closed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave those streams open after connection closure.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection and stream states can be inspected after the connection transitions to closed.

requirements.quote:
CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame {
     Type (i) = 0x1c..0x1d,
     Error Code (i),
     [Frame Type (i)],
     Reason Phrase Length (i),
     Reason Phrase (..),
   }
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the Type field as a variable-length integer whose value is 0x1c or 0x1d.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode another type value as a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The leading variable-length integer and its decoded value can be checked directly.

requirements.quote:
CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame {
     Type (i) = 0x1c..0x1d,
     Error Code (i),
     [Frame Type (i)],
     Reason Phrase Length (i),
     Reason Phrase (..),
   }
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Error Code after Type, any included Frame Type after Error Code, Reason Phrase Length after those integer fields, and Reason Phrase last.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reorder the defined fields.
requirements.why_checkable: A parser or serialized byte sequence can be checked against the specified field order.

requirements.quote:
Error Code:  A variable-length integer that indicates the reason for
      closing this connection.  A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1c
      uses codes from the space defined in Section 20.1.  A
      CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1d uses codes defined by the
      application protocol; see Section 20.2.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the Error Code field of a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode Error Code as a variable-length integer indicating the reason for closing the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoding and decoded reason value can be inspected in serialized frames.

requirements.quote:

      uses codes from the space defined in Section 20.1.  A
      CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1d uses codes defined by the

requirements.required_behavior: Select its Error Code from the QUIC error-code space defined in Section 20.1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use an application-protocol error code as the type 0x1c Error Code.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded frame type and Error Code namespace can be compared.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use the QUIC transport error-code space for the type 0x1d Error Code.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded frame type and the application protocol's error-code definitions can be compared.

requirements.quote:
Frame Type:  A variable-length integer encoding the type of frame
      that triggered the error.  A value of 0 (equivalent to the mention
      of the PADDING frame) is used when the frame type is unknown.  The
      application-specific variant of CONNECTION_CLOSE (type 0x1d) does
      not include this field.
requirements.condition: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame includes a Frame Type field.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode Frame Type as a variable-length integer identifying the frame type that triggered the error.
requirements.why_checkable: The field's integer encoding and its correspondence to the triggering frame can be tested.

requirements.quote:

      of the PADDING frame) is used when the frame type is unknown.  The
      application-specific variant of CONNECTION_CLOSE (type 0x1d) does

requirements.condition: The type of frame that triggered the error is unknown.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a Frame Type value of 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not claim a specific triggering frame type when it is unknown.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can induce an error with no known triggering frame and inspect the encoded Frame Type value.

requirements.condition: A CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame Type field has value 0.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the value as equivalent to mentioning the PADDING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoder's interpretation of the fixed value 0 can be asserted.

requirements.quote:
application-specific variant of CONNECTION_CLOSE (type 0x1d) does
      not include this field.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding an application-specific CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1d.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not include or consume a Frame Type field in this frame variant.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized layout can be checked to ensure Reason Phrase Length follows Error Code directly.

requirements.quote:
Reason Phrase Length:  A variable-length integer specifying the
      length of the reason phrase in bytes.  Because a CONNECTION_CLOSE
      frame cannot be split between packets, any limits on packet size
      will also limit the space available for a reason phrase.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding Reason Phrase Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a variable-length integer equal to the byte length of Reason Phrase.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a length that differs from the number of reason-phrase bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded integer can be compared directly with the number of following reason-phrase bytes.

requirements.quote:
length of the reason phrase in bytes.  Because a CONNECTION_CLOSE
      frame cannot be split between packets, any limits on packet size
      will also limit the space available for a reason phrase.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the complete frame, including its reason phrase, within one packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not split the CONNECTION_CLOSE frame across packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet boundaries and frame bytes can be observed to verify that no frame spans multiple packets.

requirements.quote:
Reason Phrase:  Additional diagnostic information for the closure.
      This can be zero length if the sender chooses not to give details
      beyond the Error Code value.  This SHOULD be a UTF-8 encoded
      string [RFC3629], though the frame does not carry information,
      such as language tags, that would aid comprehension by any entity
      other than the one that created the text.
requirements.condition: The sender chooses not to provide diagnostic details beyond Error Code.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender may encode a zero-length Reason Phrase.
requirements.why_checkable: A serialized frame can be checked for a zero Reason Phrase Length and no reason-phrase bytes.

requirements.quote:
beyond the Error Code value.  This SHOULD be a UTF-8 encoded
      string [RFC3629], though the frame does not carry information,
      such as language tags, that would aid comprehension by any entity
      other than the one that created the text.
requirements.condition: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame carries a Reason Phrase.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the Reason Phrase as a UTF-8 string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use invalid UTF-8 unless an implementation-specific reason justifies departing from this SHOULD.
requirements.why_checkable: The Reason Phrase byte sequence can be validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote:
The application-specific variant of CONNECTION_CLOSE (type 0x1d) can
   only be sent using 0-RTT or 1-RTT packets; see Section 12.5.  When an
   application wishes to abandon a connection during the handshake, an
   endpoint can send a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame (type 0x1c) with an error
   code of APPLICATION_ERROR in an Initial or Handshake packet.
requirements.condition: Sending an application-specific CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1d.
requirements.required_behavior: Send it only in a 0-RTT or 1-RTT packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not send type 0x1d in an Initial, Handshake, or other packet type.
requirements.why_checkable: The enclosing packet type and contained CONNECTION_CLOSE frame type can be inspected together.

requirements.condition: An application wishes to abandon a connection during the handshake using an Initial or Handshake packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may send a type 0x1c CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with Error Code APPLICATION_ERROR.
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake-abandonment test can inspect the packet type, CONNECTION_CLOSE variant, and Error Code.
